description: Fetch a web page and return clean, LLM-ready Markdown (boilerplate stripped) via ScrapingAnt. Ideal for feeding page content to a model. Example: scrapingant_markdown({ url: "https://example.com/article", _apiKey: "your-key" })

_apiKey.description: Your ScrapingAnt API key. Sign up free at https://app.scrapingant.com/signup

proxy_country.description: Two-letter ISO country code for the proxy exit location, e.g. "US".

url.description: The absolute URL of the page to convert to Markdown, e.g. "https://example.com/blog/post"

name: scrapingant_markdown
title: Scrapingant Markdown
